verdict.rationale: Trilegal is an Indian full-service law firm, a professional-services business rather than a software product with an application UI, so API-to-UI parity is a category error for this kind of product. The website's content pages, llms.txt file and DPDPA assessment tool do not make it an API-driven software platform, and probes found no OpenAPI spec at any candidate path.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can do everything through the API that I can do in the UI
